info.title: ShareFile API
info.description: Backend phase. JSON IDs are opaque; timestamps are Unix seconds and lengths/offsets are signed 64-bit byte counts (clients must avoid JavaScript number precision loss for values above 2^53). All /api/v1/admin/* routes exist only on the private LAN/VPN HTTPS listener; on the public listener they are 404 even for an administrator. The other routes are served on both listeners. Browser mutations require X-CSRF-Token and a matching Origin if supplied. Same-origin deployment; no CORS. Default errors are JSON {error:string}: 400 invalid/interrupted, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 missing, 409 conflict, 429 retry later, 507 insufficient storage, 503 unavailable storage, 500 internal. Request JSON is limited to 64 KiB. Deployment examples use insecure cookies only on explicit loopback development listeners.

post.description: Editor on parent required. An empty parent_id creates a shared root, administrator only. Duplicate visible names receive a numeric suffix. Optional Idempotency-Key (at most 128 bytes) recovers the same folder for the same user, original parent and name. Changed parameters or a trashed/moved result return 409. Permissions are rechecked; independent keys create independent folders, never merge by name. Keys remain until the corresponding node is purged.

patch.description: Content-Type application/offset+octet-stream. Chunk is streamed to HDD then fsynced before its offset is committed. A conflicting offset returns 409 without changes. Oversized chunks return 413 (chunk size, not file size). After an interruption HEAD gives the durable offset; do not blindly retry from the previous offset. On full length, the file is atomically published.

get.description: No account required. A file returns application/octet-stream with Range support; a folder returns escaped HTML with pagination. Protected links initially return 401 with an HTML password form, then require the share-specific cookie. Descendants are confined to the shared folder; no access to siblings/ancestors. Revoked, expired, disabled-creator or insufficient-creator-permission links return 404.

No account required. A file returns application/octet-stream with Range support; a folder returns escaped HTML with pagination. Protected links initially return 401 with an HTML password form, then require the share-specific cookie. Descendants are confined to the shared folder; no access to siblings/ancestors. Revoked, expired, disabled-creator or insufficient-creator-permission links return 404. Folder entries open a separate /view page with previews and retain attachment download links.

get.summary: Preview a file in a public share
get.description: Same token, password cookie, expiry, revocation and subtree checks as the share. Returns an HTML page with root-confined breadcrumbs and a download link. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP and BMP images are embedded from /preview. UTF-8 text (including HTML and SVG source) is escaped, limited to the first 256 KiB and marked when truncated. Binary files, unsupported formats and other text encodings show a download fallback. A folder redirects to its listing. HEAD is supported. 429 when transfer slots are occupied.

Same share authorization and subtree checks as /view. Streams only a sniffed JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP or BMP with explicit image MIME type, inline disposition and nosniff. Other content and folders return 400; active SVG/HTML are never served inline. Supports Range, HEAD and ETag conditional requests. 429 when transfer slots are occupied.

post.description: Checks the password and sets a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie scoped to this link, for at most 24 hours or remaining link lifetime. Foreign Origin rejected; rate limited. Wrong password returns 403.

put.description: All Config fields are editable. Paths and TLS are checked before saving. Drafts persist next to the active JSON as .pending and do not apply on ordinary startup. Use the latest revision; stale revisions or manual edits to the active file return 409. A new storage directory must be empty, have an existing writable parent, and not overlap current storage. Changing volume_id requires a different data_dir. Neither endpoint exposes certificate/key contents.

post.description: Browser administrators only. Drain HTTP requests, checkpoint/close SQLite, stream-copy changed storage to the empty target without deleting the source, atomically save the configuration, and restart listeners. A failed apply restores previous configuration; last_error explains the failure. Poll GET /admin/config on the current origin or open the new admin_url. The frontend never forwards cookies or CSRF to a new origin.
